landing.heroSubtitle: AI-powered protection against phishing, scams, impersonation and social engineering across the digital channels you use every day.
landing.threatChannelsDesc: Sentinel protects you across every digital communication channel where threats can reach you.
landing.explainableAIDesc: Every threat detection comes with a clear explanation. Sentinel tells you what it found, why it matters, and what you should do.
landing.messageProtectionDesc: Analyze SMS, WhatsApp, email and social media messages for phishing, scams and social engineering.
landing.urlIntelligenceDesc: Evaluate URLs for typosquatting, brand impersonation, suspicious patterns and known threat indicators.
landing.qrGuardianDesc: Decode QR codes and analyze their destinations before you scan. Never be redirected to a malicious site.
landing.voiceGuardDesc: Upload call recordings to detect scam patterns including urgency, fear manipulation and impersonation.
landing.cookieGuardianDesc: Analyze website privacy practices. Understand what cookies and trackers are collecting your data.
landing.step1Desc: Submit suspicious content — a message, URL, QR code, or voice recording.
landing.step2Desc: Sentinel AI analyzes the content and explains exactly what threats were found and why.
landing.step3Desc: Receive clear, actionable recommendations to stay safe.
landing.securityPhilosophyDesc: Sentinel AI is built on the principle that digital trust must be earned, not assumed. We combine AI analysis with transparent explainability.
landing.deepVoiceDesc: Detect AI-generated or cloned voices during calls.
landing.finalCTADesc: Analyze your first threat in seconds. No credit card required.
